product.title: Explore & Photograph Wild Basin in Rocky Mountain National Park with a Pro

description.text: Combine your love of hiking and photography on this two-in-one private tour. Choosing either the hike to Ouzel Falls (5.5 miles) or the hike to Calypso Cascades (3.6 miles), you'll work with your guide to grab professional long-exposure waterfall shots, wildflower macro photography, and more. Stops include Wild Basin Area, Calypso Cascades, Ouzel  Falls. With personal attention, you'll leave with a stunning portfolio of Rocky Mountain memories.Easy meetup with your guide at the Estes Park Visitor Center Choose your hiking difficulty preference, from 3.6 to Ideal for travelers basing in Estes Park or the Front Range who want a guided Rocky Mountain National Park outing without self-driving mountain roads.
